        realized_savings = run_rate * realization.get(year, Q(1))
        cost = integration.get(year, Q(0))

        return (realized_savings - cost) * (1 - tax_ratio)

    cumulative_end_y2 = None
    breakeven_time = None
    breakeven_year = None

        breakeven_time = Q(0)
        breakeven_year = 1
    else:

            start_balance = cumulative
            cash_flow = net_after_tax(year)

        return pretax * (1 - tax)

            if cum >= 0:
                # Shortfall at start of year k divided by year k's net cash flow
                breakeven_time = (k - 1) + (-start) / cf
                breakeven_year = k
                break

    return {
        "final": breakeven_time,
